title.zh-TW: 所有面板的按鈕與用量單位顯示修正
title.en: Button and Usage Unit Display Fixes Across All Panels

body.zh-TW:
以前看著面板上的數字和按鈕，有時會搞不清統計幾天或單位是什麼。每個面板的專案範圍按鈕現在都改成 `今日 ⇄`，跟 Antigravity 的 `Gemini ⇄` 一致，讓人一眼看得出點下去會依序切到今日、昨日、7 日、月和全部。

v0.5.0 把面板換成網頁版面後，專案與今日總量旁的單位一度消失。現在完整數字後面都會補上較小較淡的 `tokens`（AI 計算用量的文字單位），例如 `567,641 tokens`，數字維持精確不縮寫。最窄的面板把專案名稍微縮小，九位數旁也放得下 13 個字元的名稱。

以前隱藏 Claude Code 後，「設定」按鈕移到下一張卡卻緊貼標題，在 Antigravity 卡上則黏在 Gemini 按鈕旁。現在它會跟在 Claude Code 卡上一樣，靠在最右邊。
body.en:
Looking at the numbers and buttons in a panel used to leave you unsure how many days were counted or what the unit was. Every panel's project range button now reads `Today ⇄`, matching the Antigravity `Gemini ⇄` button, so you can tell at a glance that clicking it steps through Today, Yesterday, 7 Days, Month, and All Time.

After v0.5.0 switched the panels to a web layout, the unit next to project and daily totals went missing. Every full count is now followed by a smaller, quieter `tokens` (text units AI uses to measure usage), such as `567,641 tokens`, while the numbers stay exact and un-abbreviated. The narrowest panels shrink the project name slightly so a 13-character name still fits beside a nine-digit count.

Previously, hiding Claude Code moved the Settings button to the next card right up against the title, or right next to the Gemini button on the Antigravity card. It now stays at the far right edge, just as it does on the Claude Code card.

items.original:
**Every panel shows that the project range button cycles.** The button reads `Today ⇄`, matching the Antigravity `Gemini ⇄` button, so it is clear that clicking it steps through Today, Yesterday, 7 Days, Month and All Time.
**Token counts in the panel show their unit again.** The `tokens` unit next to project and daily totals went missing when the panels moved to HTML in v0.5.0, so numbers like `567,641` had no label. Every panel now shows the full count followed by a smaller, quieter `tokens`, for example `567,641 tokens`. Counts stay exact and are never abbreviated. In the narrowest panels the project name is slightly smaller, so a 13-character name still fits beside a nine-digit count.
**The settings button stays at the right edge of the card.** Before this fix, hiding Claude Code moved the button to the next card but left it right after the card title, or right after the Gemini button on the Antigravity card. It now sits at the right edge, as it does on the Claude Code card.

title.zh-TW: Windows 95 面板字級與長條調整
title.en: Windows 95 Panel Text Sizes and Bar Adjustments

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 95 面板上，以前卡片標題竟比底下的列還小，`Gemini ⇄` 按鈕也比標題列其他按鈕小一號。現在六種字級收成三種，卡片標題、列標題、百分比和今日總計都是 15 px（像素，螢幕上的點數單位）。專案列、速率列和所有按鈕改成 13 px，重置時間、金額和署名則是 11 px。

專案長條也從原本的 3 px 拉高到 8 px，第一名則是 9 px。以前 3 px 扣掉立體邊框只剩約 1 px 綠色，根本比不出長短，現在一眼就分得出高下。⟦就像把字體大小亂跳、進度條細成一條線的手寫帳本，重新劃好大中小三種格線並塗粗長條，哪項花最多立刻分明。⟧
body.en:
In the Windows 95 panel, card titles used to be smaller than the rows below them, and the `Gemini ⇄` button was a size smaller than the other title-bar buttons. Six text sizes are now consolidated into three: card titles, row labels, percentages, and the daily total are 15 px (pixels, the dot units on a screen). Project rows, the rate line, and all buttons are 13 px, while reset times, costs, and the credit line are 11 px.

Project bars also grew from 3 px to 8 px tall, and 9 px for the top project. Previously, subtracting the beveled border from 3 px left only about 1 px of green, making it impossible to compare lengths, whereas now you can tell them apart at a glance. ⟦Picture a handwritten ledger with erratic font sizes and hairline progress bars being redrawn with neat large, medium, and small rulings and thick bars, so the biggest expense stands out immediately.⟧

items.original:
**The Windows 95 panel uses three text sizes instead of six.** Card titles, row labels, percentages and the daily total are 15 px; project rows, the rate line and every button are 13 px; reset times, costs and the credit line are 11 px. Before this, card titles were smaller than the rows below them, and the `Gemini ⇄` button was smaller than the other title-bar buttons.
**Project bars in the Windows 95 panel are easier to compare.** They were 3 px tall, and the beveled border left about 1 px of green. They are now 8 px tall, 9 px for the top project.

title.zh-TW: 復古報紙等四款面板風格與間距統一
title.en: Unified Style and Spacing for Four Panels Including Newspaper

body.zh-TW:
這幾款主題面板過去有些零件跟周圍畫風不太搭，或上下擠成一團，現在都比照同張卡的元件對齊了。

在復古報紙面板裡，專案長條原本是圓角細條，現在改成跟額度長條一樣的方角細框。`Gemini ⇄` 按鈕也從膠囊形改成跟「設定」一致的方角，Antigravity 圖示則加上灰色方塊底，比照 Claude Code 圖示。

稜鏡街機面板的專案用量卡片以前只用字母 `P` 頂著，像還沒畫完的佔位符號。現在換成資料夾裡有幾根小長條的圖示，並放進跟 Antigravity、Grok 同款的徽章裡。

雲朵觀測、水族箱與稜鏡街機面板的底部卡片也變寬鬆了。速率列和今日總計原本離中間分隔線只有 5 px，現在上下各拉開到 8 px，跟按鈕上方的間距一致。
body.en:
Several themed panels used to have parts that clashed with their surroundings or felt cramped vertically, and they are now aligned with the rest of each card.

In the Newspaper panel, project bars used to be thin rounded strips and now use the same square, outlined track as the quota bars. The `Gemini ⇄` button switched from pill-shaped to square like the Settings button, and the Antigravity icon now sits on a gray square like the Claude Code icon.

The Prism Arcade panel's project usage card used to show just the letter `P`, looking like an unfinished placeholder. It now displays a folder with small bars inside, placed in the same badge style as the Antigravity and Grok icons.

The bottom card in the Cloud Observation, Aquarium, and Prism Arcade panels also has more breathing room. The rate line and daily total used to sit just 5 px from the center divider, and the gap is now 8 px on both sides, matching the space above the buttons.

items.original:
**The Newspaper panel looks like one design.** Project bars were thin rounded strips; they now use the same square, outlined track as the quota bars. The `Gemini ⇄` button is square like the settings button instead of pill-shaped, and the Antigravity icon sits on a gray square like the Claude Code icon.
**The bottom card in the Cloud Observation, Aquarium and Prism Arcade panels has more room.** The rate line and the daily total sat 5 px from the divider between them; the gap is now 8 px on each side, matching the space above the buttons.
**The Prism Arcade project card has an icon instead of the letter `P`.** It now shows a folder with small bars, in the same badge as the Antigravity and Grok icons, so it no longer looks like a placeholder.

title.zh-TW: 面板文字與按鈕不再被遮擋或融成一片
title.en: Panel Text and Buttons No Longer Covered or Blending In

body.zh-TW:
背景配色淡到看不清，或裝飾線條壓到卡片內容，讀起數據就會很吃力。雲朵觀測面板的 `Gemini ⇄` 按鈕原本淡紫到在白色玻璃卡上幾乎消失，現在改用跟 Antigravity 圖示同款的深紫色。圖示圓底也從半透明白改成淡紫色，不再融進卡片。

心電監視器面板的額度長條原本離重置時間那行只有 2 px，80% 刻度還會頂到文字，現在間距拉開到 6 px。

摺紙面板第一名徽章曾是一半淺一半深，讓白色的 `1` 消失，現在改成兩種深藍。卡片右下角摺角也縮小且只在尖端保留深色，讓重置時間、百分比和金額都落在淺色紙面上。

蝶類圖鑑面板的蝴蝶飛過卡片中段時不透明度曾達 85%，線條會壓住重置時間、「設定」按鈕和狀態列。現在最高降到約 45%，蝴蝶照樣飛過卡片，底下的字卻看得清楚。
body.en:
Reading data gets hard when background colors fade out or decorative lines cross over card content. In the Cloud Observation panel, the `Gemini ⇄` button used to be such a pale purple that it nearly vanished on the white glass card, and it now uses the same deep purple as the Antigravity icon. The icon's backing circle also changed from translucent white to light purple so it no longer blends into the card.

In the Heart Monitor panel, the quota bars used to sit only 2 px below the reset time line, with the 80% tick poking into the text; the gap is now 6 px.

The Origami panel's first-place badge used to be half light and half dark, causing the white `1` to disappear, and is now two shades of deep blue. The folded corner at the bottom right of each card is also smaller and dark only at the tip, keeping reset times, percentages, and costs on light paper.

In the Lepidoptera panel, butterflies flying across the middle of the cards used to reach 85% opacity, covering reset times, the Settings button, and the status line with their outlines. Their peak opacity is now down to about 45%, so they still fly across the cards while the text underneath stays clear.

items.original:
**The Antigravity header in the Cloud Observation panel is easier to read.** The `Gemini ⇄` button used a pale purple that nearly disappeared on the white glass card; it now uses the same deep purple as the Antigravity icon. The icon's backing circle, which was translucent white, is now light purple, so it no longer blends into the card.
**The Heart Monitor panel's quota bars no longer touch the reset time.** The bar sat 2 px below the reset line, and its 80% tick rose into the text. The gap is now 6 px.
**The Origami panel no longer hides text under its dark folds.** The first-place rank badge was half light and half dark, so its white `1` disappeared. The folded corner at the bottom right of each card was dark where the last reset time sat. The badge is now two shades of deep blue, and the corner fold is smaller and dark only at its tip, so reset times, percentages and costs stay on light paper.
**The butterflies in the Lepidoptera panel no longer hide the text they fly over.** They drift above the cards and reached 85% opacity mid-flight, so their outlines covered reset times, the Settings button and the status line. They now peak at about 45%, so the text stays readable while they still fly over the cards.

title.zh-TW: Catppuccin 還原大小寫並標出配色
title.en: Catppuccin Restores Letter Case and Labels Each Flavor

body.zh-TW:
Catppuccin 面板過去會把 `esun-daytrade` 這類專案名硬轉成全大寫 `ESUN-DAYTRADE`，連今日總計的 `TOKENS` 都跟專案列的 `tokens` 寫法不一。現在專案名與單位都保留原本的大小寫，標籤和按鈕則維持大寫。

底部用來切換配色的四個方塊原本沒寫字，三個深色款擺在一起幾乎分不出來。現在每個方塊底下都標上了 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 與 Mocha 的名稱，選中的那一格也會特別標示出來。⟦跟把樣本盒裡沒貼標、全寫大字的色卡重新貼上原字名牌一樣，專案與配色都能一眼認出。⟧
body.en:
The Catppuccin panel used to force project names like `esun-daytrade` into all-caps `ESUN-DAYTRADE`, and even the daily total showed `TOKENS` while project rows read `tokens`. Project names and the unit now keep their original case, while labels and buttons stay uppercase.

The four squares at the bottom for switching flavors used to have no text, making the three dark ones nearly indistinguishable side by side. Each square now has its name—Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha—labeled underneath, with the selected one highlighted. ⟦Like putting original-case name tags back onto unlabeled, all-caps color swatches in a sample box, both projects and flavors are now recognizable at a glance.⟧

items.original:
**The Catppuccin panel shows project names in their real case.** Names were forced to uppercase, so `esun-daytrade` appeared as `ESUN-DAYTRADE`, and the daily total read `TOKENS` while project rows read `tokens`. Project names and the unit now keep their case; labels and buttons stay uppercase.
**The Catppuccin flavor switcher labels each swatch.** The four squares at the bottom had no text, and the three dark flavors looked almost the same. Each square now has its name below it (Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, Mocha), and the selected one is highlighted.

title.zh-TW: 楓紅黃昏落葉與黑洞星空細節更新
title.en: Maple Dusk Fallen Leaves and Black Hole Starfield Details Updated

body.zh-TW:
楓紅黃昏面板底部的兩個角落，以前各有三片落葉擠在約 50 px 內，有的側躺倒立、還壓在卡片框線上。現在改成每角一大一小兩片，接近平放並帶淡淡陰影，落在底部卡片下方。

黑洞面板則讓 120 顆背景星星不再像靜止貼圖。以前只有 8 顆會微弱變亮，黑洞在轉但背景毫無動靜。現在有 40 顆星各自用不同速度忽明忽暗，最大的六顆亮到極點時還會閃出小小十字星芒。⟦簡直像把原本歪斜擠在角落的紙片裝飾跟不怎麼亮的背景燈泡，重新擺好位置並換上各自明滅的星燈。⟧
body.en:
In the Maple Dusk panel's two bottom corners, three fallen leaves used to crowd into about 50 px on each side, some sideways or upside down and overlapping the card border. Each corner now has two leaves—one large and one small—lying nearly flat with a soft shadow below the bottom card.

In the Black Hole panel, the 120 background stars no longer look like a static sticker. Previously only 8 stars brightened slightly, leaving the backdrop motionless while the black hole spun. Now 40 stars fade in and out at their own pace, and the six largest flash a tiny cross-shaped glint at their brightest. ⟦Think of rearranging crooked paper cutouts crammed in the corners and swapping dim background bulbs for star lights that each twinkle on their own.⟧

items.original:
**The fallen leaves in the Maple Dusk panel's bottom corners look like they landed.** Each corner had three leaves crowded into about 50 px, some turned sideways or upside down and lying across the card border. Each corner now has one large and one small leaf, lying nearly flat with a soft shadow, below the bottom card.
**The stars in the Black Hole panel twinkle.** Only 8 of 120 stars changed brightness, and only slightly, so the background looked still while the black hole turned. Now 40 stars fade in and out, each at its own pace, and the six largest flash a small four-point glint at their brightest.

title.zh-TW: 「接著上次做」會完整交接上回結尾
title.en: "Pick Up Where You Left Off" Hands Over the Full Session Ending

body.zh-TW:
換開新對話接手進度，以前交接筆記只列 Claude 做的 commit（版本存檔紀錄），你用 `!` 跑的合併、tag 與推送全漏掉。就算上個工作階段做完了，它仍叫 Claude 硬給下一步。

現在會帶上 Claude Code 的整場摘要，摘要後無新動作才用，否則改附它最後一則回覆的開頭幾句。它也會由新到舊列出成功的合併 PR（合併請求）、建立的 tag 和推送，並請 Claude 做完就直說做完了，別自己編下一步。

對話壓縮的系統文字不再被當成最新請求，Claude 忙時排隊送出的訊息也會收進來。補充說明後重送的請求只列一次，按 `/clear` 後優先接這個視窗剛清掉的那場。「沒提交的改動」改為說明目前工作目錄狀態，因為它在新對話開始時才檢查。⟦像交接班以前只抄自己經手的事，現在連對方動過的進度與結尾都寫進交接本，做完就直接結案。⟧
body.en:
When you opened a new conversation to continue your work, the handoff note used to list only the commits (saved version records) Claude made, missing every merge, tag, and push you ran with `!`. Even when the last session was already finished, it still told Claude to propose a next step.

Now it includes Claude Code's end-of-session recap when nothing happened after it, or the opening sentences of Claude's last reply otherwise. It also lists successful merged PRs (pull requests), created tags, and pushes from newest to oldest, and tells Claude to say a finished round is finished instead of inventing a next step.

Compaction system text is no longer treated as your latest request, and messages queued while Claude was busy are now included. A request resent with extra detail is listed only once, and after `/clear` it prioritizes the session this window just cleared. The "uncommitted changes" line now says it describes the current working directory, because it is checked when the new conversation starts. ⟦Just as a shift handoff used to record only what one person touched, the logbook now captures the other person's progress and how things wrapped up, closing out cleanly when the job is done.⟧

items.original: **Pick Up Where You Left Off now hands over how the last session ended.** Before this fix, the note a new conversation received listed only commits Claude made, so merges, tags and pushes you ran yourself with `!` were missing, and Claude was always told to propose a next step even when the last round was finished. The note now adds Claude Code's own end-of-session recap, used only when nothing happened after it, or else the opening sentences of Claude's last reply. It lists merged PRs, created tags and pushes that succeeded, newest first, and tells Claude to say a finished round is finished instead of inventing a next step. Claude Code's compaction text is no longer shown as your latest request, messages you queued while Claude was busy are now included, a request you resent with more detail is listed once, and after `/clear` the note picks the conversation this window just cleared. The uncommitted-changes line now says it describes the current working directory, because it is checked when the new conversation starts.
